scope: One-machine fixed mask ablation; source and full dual consumers stay actual.
evidence: CPU payload slot prototype; not RTL/PPA/full-frame.

source_program.interface: Spatial/T/C packed24 input; spatial/C packedT10 gate output. Original I24 remains external and is reread later; no full-window I24 retention claimed.

consumer.input_contract: Each raw I24 pixel is 2880 contiguous bytes, spatial/T/C order; source-side packing not covered.
consumer.common_baseline: Direct V completion, actual V24 spill for post-BN reread.

independent_oracle.oracle: Independent NumPy integer matrix execution, legal accumulators <2**47, FP64 exact integer storage; RNE and signed24 saturation at original boundaries.
